answer: Score each identity by a behavioral fingerprint: which tools it uses, in what order, and with what timing. A trellis keeps vines apart so each can be judged on its own growth; the network does the same, clustering fingerprints and merging identities that share a bridge of identical behavior into one influence quota instead of letting them multiply. A sybil operator must build a separate pattern for every fake identity, paying time, skill and compute each time. Like a juniper grown from one cutting, a copied fingerprint soon shows its identical growth pattern, and its quota is revoked.
